title: Sigma Gamma Rho Special Registration Plate
lastAction: Ref To Com On Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill authorizes North Carolina's Division of Motor Vehicles to create and issue a special registration plate for Sigma Gamma Rho sorority members. The plate would display the sorority's symbol, name, and the phrase 'Greater Service, Greater Progress.'
aiProArguments: Supporters argue that special registration plates allow organizations and groups to celebrate their identity and community service. Sigma Gamma Rho, a historically Black sorority founded in 1922, has a long tradition of community service and philanthropy. Allowing members to display a plate recognizing their affiliation promotes organizational pride and visibility.
aiConArguments: Opponents may argue that creating numerous special registration plates increases administrative costs for the Division of Motor Vehicles and creates equity questions about which organizations qualify. Some may question whether government resources should be used to promote specific private organizations, or whether allowing many special plates diminishes their uniqueness and appeal.
